old: Hybrid work makes the complementarity of the two strategies explicit: \citet{haeufle_benefit_2018} combined feed-forward muscle activations with neuronal reflex feedback in simulated human walking and found that the robustness benefit of each depends on which muscle carries it.
new: \citet{haeufle_benefit_2018} combined pre-recorded muscle activation patterns (feed-forward control) with sensory reflex responses (feedback control) in a simulated human walking model. They tested whether the model could keep walking after an unexpected drop in ground height. The benefit of combining the signals depended on the muscle being controlled and on the proportion of activation supplied by each signal.
